title: Milo’s Lemonade Copycat Recipe
description: Make a pitcher inspired by Milo’s Lemonade with fresh lemon juice, cane sugar and filtered water. No chocolate malt powder is used.
author: Better Sweet Drinks
ingredients: 1 cup freshly squeezed lemon juice (about 4–6 lemons)
Ice and lemon slices for serving; mint optional
instructions:
1. Juice the lemons and strain out seeds.
  2. Warm 1 cup water with the cane sugar, stirring until dissolved; let the syrup cool.
  3. Mix lemon juice, cooled syrup and remaining 4 cups water in a pitcher.
  4. Taste and adjust with water, lemon or dissolved sugar. Chill or serve immediately over ice.
  5. Stir again and serve with lemon slices or mint if desired.
notes: For a less sweet variation, start with 3/4 cup sugar and adjust after mixing. Add ice to individual glasses to avoid diluting the pitcher.
keywords: Milo's Lemonade copycat, homemade lemonade, lemon juice
